name: @airprompter/agent-otel
description: The AirPrompter agent SDK's telemetry spool as an OpenTelemetry exporter: minute windows become OTLP metrics (gen_ai.client.operation.duration, tokens, checks, feedback, refusals) shipped to the collector you already run, with no AirPrompter grant at all. An UploadSink for the uploader in @airprompter/agent-sdk/telemetry, in airprompterd or in-process.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
